title: Weighted marked-subset dimension refinement and complete coefficient-four certificates

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total weighted-selection certificate-prefix family defined at every length in proof.md Sections1--2 and family.py. Enumerate all prime2<=k<N, r=ceil((N-k)/k) with r>=3 and k>r+1, and2<=t<r. Use d=H+max(T,floor(F_r))+1 when k>=2r+1 and2k>=(t+1)^2, where H=r(r+3)/2,T=(t-1)k-t(t+1)/2+1,h=ceil(2r/(t+1)),F_r=r(2k-2r-1+h)/(2(t+1)); otherwise use d_old=H+max(T,floor(U/(t+1)))+1, U=rk-r(r+1)/2. Require B=t(t+3)/2<=d<N-k and select the lexicographically least(4k+8d-4B-3,k,t), with zero output if none exists. Read the paid degree-k polynomial prefix, reject invalid prefixes, and evaluate the descending-power order-t BK symmetric payload polynomial with zero padding.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This one fixed total language is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. For every actual integer length N, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-L_N, with L_N the exact selected loss or4N when no pair is admissible. Every sufficiently large integer length is admissible and L_N=O(N^(4/5))=o(N). The guarded weighted marked-subset selection theorem supplies degree>=B on every dimension-d affine payload space and the retained full-B2 theorem supplies4m-8d+4B+3. Therefore for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N for every integer N>=N_epsilon in the full Li-Yang B2 model.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: The exact original reference search defined in proof.md Section6 is nonempty at every sufficiently large actual N, and L_N<=L_old(N) whenever that reference search is nonempty. These are complete certified losses, not actual circuit-size comparisons. Exact enumeration gives (L_old,L_N)=(669,661) at N=200,(2533,2493) at N=1000,and(16809,16601) at N=10000, as checked by finite-audit and explained in proof.md.

experiments.purpose: Exact bounded marked-subset marginals, positive-deficit selection, field-prefix and evaluator predicates, and exhaustive finite parameter-oracle comparisons. Finite checks do not prove universal circuit coverage or asymptotics.
